CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_prune_research_requests()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare n integer;
begin
 delete from icash_research_private.estimates where operation_key in (
  select operation_key from icash_research_private.estimates where updated_at<now()-interval '1 day'
   and (lease_until is null or lease_until<=now()) order by updated_at limit 1000 for update skip locked);
 delete from icash_research_private.requests where id in (select request.id from icash_research_private.requests request where request.created_at<now()-interval '30 days' and not exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.owner_preflight_quota_deferrals proof where proof.request_id=request.id) and not exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.preview_rejection_recoveries proof where proof.request_id=request.id) and not exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.stalled_searches proof where proof.request_id=request.id) and not exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.owner_empty_preview_receipts proof where proof.request_id=request.id) and not exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.export_capacity_probes proof where proof.request_id=request.id) and not exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.owner_export_quota_requests proof where proof.request_id=request.id) order by request.created_at limit 10000);
 get diagnostics n=row_count;return n;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_research_private.capacity_probe_response_fresh(p_receipt jsonb, p_started timestamp with time zone, p_received timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare d text:=p_receipt#>>'{headers,date}';age jsonb:=p_receipt#>'{headers,age}';stamp timestamptz;
begin
 if d is null or d !~ '^(Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun), [0-9]{2} (Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec) [0-9]{4} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} GMT$'
  or jsonb_typeof(p_receipt#>'{headers,date}') is distinct from 'string'
  or age is null or (age is distinct from 'null'::jsonb and age is distinct from '"0"'::jsonb)
  or p_started is null or p_received is null then return false;end if;
 stamp:=d::timestamptz;
 return stamp>=date_trunc('second',p_started)-interval '5 seconds'
  and stamp<=p_received+interval '5 seconds' and p_received>=p_started;
exception when others then return false;
end $function$
